prompt:
Create one single full-body illustration of Vivhite as a production master for a weighted 2D skeletal animation rig. Images 1, 2 and 3 define the same character and are authoritative for her identity and costume: silver-white short bob hair, vivid violet-pink eyes, round gold glasses, blue butterfly hair ornament, refined white and deep navy magical-girl dress with restrained gold and violet crystal details, white thigh-high stockings and dark ankle boots. Preserve her cute, luxurious, cool and emotionally distant expression. Use polished 2D cel-animation rendering with clean controlled shapes, crisp physical contours, matte non-emissive costume surfaces and restrained interior cel shading.

Show exactly one Vivhite in a three-quarter side combat stance facing screen-right, because the player stands on the left and enemies stand on the right. This must be a new magical-girl pose, not a swordsman pose and not the pose from Image 1. Keep her complete body visible from hair tip to both boot soles with generous clear margin on all four sides. Her torso turns toward screen-right, hips and shoulders form a readable three-quarter silhouette, knees are softly bent and both feet are separated in a balanced ready stance. Her near arm bends naturally with the open empty palm raised toward screen-right at chest height, ready to release magic; her far arm stays lower and slightly behind with another relaxed open empty hand. Leave clear negative space between both arms and the torso, between the hands and skirt, between both legs, and around every major joint. Make both shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles anatomically clear so a custom shoulder-elbow-wrist and hip-knee-ankle bone chain can deform the image naturally. Keep all five fingers plausible and readable on each visible hand.

Every highlight, shadow and color must stop at the physical character contour. Outside the physical silhouette, render no painted marks. No weapon or held object of any kind. No sword, blade, staff, wand, rod, spear, spellbook, shield or orb. No warrior armor, sword grip, weapon-ready posture or Ironclad pose. No magic effect, magic circle, spell arc, aura, outer glow, bloom, radiance, rim light, backlight, luminous outline, haze, smoke, particles, detached light, floor, contact shadow, cast shadow, scenery, decorative frame, typography, logo, signature or watermark. No character sheet, turnaround, sprite sheet, panel grid, inset, duplicate pose, alternate costume, multiple views, extra person, extra limb, duplicated hand, duplicated finger, missing finger, long white ribbon, silk strip, bandage, helmet or heavy armor.
